D.t: Christina Bohannan leads by 10.6 in the forecast and wins 97% of simulations. The cushion is about 36,286 votes; a one point swing is about 1,720 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +3.5 and D +17.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$3.0M cash against $2.6M. Roughly even money; the air war will be decided by outside groups and earned media.
